Citizens{{Cite web|url=https://www.mfa.com.mt/en/news/news/3711/valletta-edge-balzan-to-capture-bov-super-cup.htm|title=Valletta edge Balzan to capture BOV Super Cup|access-date=2020-07-16|publication-date=2018-12-13|archive-date=3 August 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200803231235/https://mfa.com.mt/en/news/news/3711/valletta-edge-balzan-to-capture-bov-super-cup.htm|url-status=live}} | founded = {{start date and age|1943}} | chairman = Claudio Grech | manager = Thane Micallef | league = [[Maltese Premier League]] | season = [[2026–27 Maltese Premier League|2026–27]] | position = Maltese Premier League, 4th of 12 | website = {{URL|http://www.vallettafc.net/}} | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _nikepark7wr | pattern_ra1 = | leftarm1 = FFFFFF | body1 = FFFFFF | rightarm1 = FFFFFF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = FFFFFF | pattern_la2 = _nikechallenge5urw | pattern_b2 = _nikechallenge5urw | pattern_ra2 = _nikechallenge5urw | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FF0000 | body2 = FF0000 | rightarm2 = FF0000 | shorts2 = FF0000 | socks2 = FF0000 }} '''Valletta F.C.''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Valletta]], the capital city of [[Malta]]. The club currently competes in the [[Maltese Premier League]]. The club was founded in 1943 after a merge of Valletta Prestons, Valletta St. Paul's and Valletta United, the latter being a two-time league winner before the [[World War II|Second World War]]. Considered one of the most supported and successful clubs in Maltese football,{{cite web |url=https://mfa.com.mt/en/news/news/3564/uefa-study-confirms-football-as-most-popular-sport-in-malta.htm |title=UEFA-MFA study confirms football as no.1 sport in Malta |publisher=Malta Football Association |date=26 September 2018 |access-date=14 October 2018 |archive-date=14 October 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181014165237/https://mfa.com.mt/en/news/news/3564/uefa-study-confirms-football-as-most-popular-sport-in-malta.htm |url-status=dead }} the club has won 25 [[List of Maltese football champions|league titles]], 15 [[Maltese FA Trophy|FA Trophies]] and a record 14 [[Maltese Super Cup|Super Cups]]. During the 2021–22 season the club was sponsored by Meridianbet.{{cite web | title= With a goal to promote Maltese sport, Meridianbet sponsored two football clubs during the 2021/22 season!| website=TVM News| date=10 July 2022 | url=https://tvmnews.mt/en/news/with-a-goal-to-promote-maltese-sport-meridianbet-sponsored-two-football-clubs-during-the-2021-22-season/ | access-date=28 May 2024}}"}}
